governing_principle: Build the complete framework first, then deepen each module without over-engineering the foundation.

master_phases.name: Blueprint tổng thể
master_phases.exit_criteria: Sitemap, four pillars, repository architecture, data flow and naming conventions are defined.

master_phases.name: Xây Skeleton Website
master_phases.exit_criteria: Home + Market + Legal + Infrastructure + Macro render through a shared responsive shell.

master_phases.name: Thiết kế Data Architecture
master_phases.exit_criteria: Core entities, relationships, source registry and canonical field conventions exist for all four pillars.

master_phases.name: Data Layer bản đơn giản
master_phases.exit_criteria: Website is data-driven from structured JSON with shared search/filter/sort/chart utilities.

master_phases.name: Source Registry & Auto Data Collection
master_phases.exit_criteria: All four modules have a defined Source → Fetch/Assist → Parse → Normalize → Deduplicate → Candidate path. Legal and Infrastructure must move beyond fingerprint/watch-only discovery.

master_phases.name: Automation
master_phases.exit_criteria: Automatable sources refresh on schedule; blocked/manual sources are explicitly classified; failures, stale data, last-good retention and candidate backlog are visible through one operations layer.

master_phases.name: Intelligence Database
master_phases.exit_criteria: Project / Region / Developer / Time views can query and connect Market, Legal, Infrastructure and Macro evidence without fabricating missing data.

master_phases.name: Intelligence, Ranking & AI optional
master_phases.exit_criteria: Rule-based importance/change ranking powers Today / This Week / What Changed / Top Developments; AI remains an optional analysis layer above canonical data.
